patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Klaviyo and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Klaviyo and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Klaviyo only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, and active-” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Klaviyo's shape. Workflow advantage: Klaviyo leans ecommerce-email; Mailjet leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Klaviyo and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Klaviyo is Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, and active-profile billing.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: Klaviyo (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Klaviyo-leaning ecommerce-email vs Mailjet-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Klaviyo — Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Klaviyo: Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows; Exact paid-band dollars require the live pricing slider — floors are research estimates; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Klaviyo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Klaviyo if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
